cards.front: What is the primary function of an engine?
cards.back: To convert fuel into mechanical energy to power the vehicle

cards.front: What are the four strokes of a four-stroke engine?
cards.back: Intake, compression, power, and exhaust strokes

cards.front: What is the purpose of the transmission?
cards.back: To transfer power from the engine to the wheels at different speeds

cards.front: What is the difference between automatic and manual transmission?
cards.back: Automatic shifts gears automatically, while manual requires driver to shift gears

cards.front: What is the purpose of the brake system?
cards.back: To slow down or stop the vehicle safely

cards.front: What is the difference between disc and drum brakes?
cards.back: Disc brakes use pads and rotors, while drum brakes use shoes and drums

cards.front: What is the purpose of the suspension system?
cards.back: To provide a smooth ride and maintain tire contact with the road

cards.front: What is the purpose of the steering system?
cards.back: To control the direction of the vehicle

cards.front: What is the purpose of the electrical system?
cards.back: To provide power for starting, lighting, and other electrical components

cards.front: What is the purpose of the cooling system?
cards.back: To regulate engine temperature and prevent overheating

cards.front: What is the purpose of the lubrication system?
cards.back: To reduce friction and wear between moving parts

cards.front: What is the purpose of the fuel system?
cards.back: To deliver fuel to the engine for combustion

cards.front: What is the purpose of the exhaust system?
cards.back: To remove exhaust gases from the engine and reduce noise

cards.front: What is the purpose of the air intake system?
cards.back: To provide clean air to the engine for combustion

cards.front: What is the purpose of the ignition system?
cards.back: To create a spark to ignite the fuel-air mixture

cards.front: What is the purpose of the charging system?
cards.back: To recharge the battery and power electrical components

cards.front: What is the purpose of the starting system?
cards.back: To crank the engine and start the vehicle

cards.front: What is the purpose of the lighting system?
cards.back: To provide visibility and signal other drivers

cards.front: What is the purpose of the heating and air conditioning system?
cards.back: To maintain comfortable temperature inside the vehicle

cards.front: What is the purpose of the windshield wiper system?
cards.back: To clear rain and debris from the windshield

cards.front: What is the purpose of the horn system?
cards.back: To alert other drivers and pedestrians

cards.front: What is the purpose of the seat belt system?
cards.back: To restrain occupants in case of a collision

cards.front: What is the purpose of the airbag system?
cards.back: To protect occupants from injury in a collision

cards.front: What is the purpose of the anti-lock brake system (ABS)?
cards.back: To prevent wheel lockup during hard braking

cards.front: What is the purpose of the traction control system?
cards.back: To prevent wheel spin during acceleration

cards.front: What is the purpose of the stability control system?
cards.back: To help maintain vehicle control during turns

cards.front: What is the purpose of the cruise control system?
cards.back: To maintain a constant speed without driver input

cards.front: What is the purpose of the power steering system?
cards.back: To make steering easier by using hydraulic or electric assistance

cards.front: What is the purpose of the power windows system?
cards.back: To raise and lower windows using electric motors

cards.front: What is the purpose of the power locks system?
cards.back: To lock and unlock doors using electric actuators

cards.front: What is the purpose of the alarm system?
cards.back: To deter theft and alert others of unauthorized access

cards.front: What is the purpose of the remote keyless entry system?
cards.back: To lock and unlock doors remotely using a key fob

cards.front: What is the purpose of the tire pressure monitoring system?
cards.back: To monitor tire pressure and alert the driver of low pressure

cards.front: What is the purpose of the backup camera system?
cards.back: To provide a view behind the vehicle when reversing

cards.front: What is the purpose of the parking assist system?
cards.back: To help the driver park the vehicle safely

cards.front: What is the purpose of the lane departure warning system?
cards.back: To alert the driver when the vehicle drifts out of its lane

cards.front: What is the purpose of the blind spot monitoring system?
cards.back: To alert the driver of vehicles in blind spots

cards.front: What is the purpose of the forward collision warning system?
cards.back: To alert the driver of potential frontal collisions

cards.front: What is the purpose of the automatic emergency braking system?
cards.back: To automatically apply brakes to prevent or reduce collision impact

cards.front: What is the purpose of the adaptive cruise control system?
cards.back: To maintain a safe following distance from the vehicle ahead

cards.front: What is the purpose of the lane keeping assist system?
cards.back: To help keep the vehicle centered in its lane

cards.front: What is the purpose of the traffic sign recognition system?
cards.back: To recognize and display traffic signs to the driver

cards.front: What is the purpose of the night vision system?
cards.back: To enhance visibility in low-light conditions

cards.front: What is the purpose of the head-up display system?
cards.back: To project important information onto the windshield

cards.front: What is the purpose of the infotainment system?
cards.back: To provide entertainment and information to the driver and passengers

cards.front: What is the purpose of the navigation system?
cards.back: To provide directions and route guidance to the driver

cards.front: What is the purpose of the Bluetooth system?
cards.back: To connect mobile devices wirelessly to the vehicle

cards.front: What is the purpose of the USB port system?
cards.back: To connect and charge electronic devices

cards.front: What is the purpose of the auxiliary input system?
cards.back: To connect external audio devices to the vehicle's sound system

cards.front: What is the purpose of the satellite radio system?
cards.back: To receive satellite radio broadcasts

cards.front: What is the purpose of the HD radio system?
cards.back: To receive high-definition radio broadcasts

cards.front: What is the purpose of the CD player system?
cards.back: To play compact discs in the vehicle

cards.front: What is the purpose of the DVD player system?
cards.back: To play DVDs in the vehicle for rear-seat entertainment

cards.front: What is the purpose of the rear-seat entertainment system?
cards.back: To provide entertainment for rear-seat passengers

cards.front: What is the purpose of the wireless charging system?
cards.back: To charge compatible devices without cables

cards.front: What is the purpose of the Wi-Fi hotspot system?
cards.back: To provide internet connectivity for passengers' devices

cards.front: What is the purpose of the smartphone integration system?
cards.back: To integrate smartphone functions with the vehicle's systems

cards.front: What is the purpose of the voice recognition system?
cards.back: To control vehicle functions using voice commands

cards.front: What is the purpose of the gesture control system?
cards.back: To control vehicle functions using hand gestures

cards.front: What is the purpose of the touch screen system?
cards.back: To control vehicle functions using touch input

cards.front: What is the purpose of the steering wheel controls?
cards.back: To control vehicle functions without taking hands off the wheel

cards.front: What is the purpose of the instrument cluster?
cards.back: To display important vehicle information to the driver

cards.front: What is the purpose of the warning light system?
cards.back: To alert the driver of potential problems or issues

cards.front: What is the purpose of the diagnostic system?
cards.back: To identify and report vehicle problems for repair
